about: Phase 62: labelled replies for the receipt check (src/receipts.ts). Each item is one reply Sara might write, the tools that really ran (status ok) in that turn, and whether the reply makes an action claim those tools do NOT back (claim: true = it should be flagged). Written by hand for Sara (invented people and files), half positive per language. 'dev' was written first and the Phase 62 patterns were tuned on it, so its scores are optimistic; 'heldout' was written after the patterns were frozen and never used to tune them: report it as the real number. Tools: 'name', 'name:action' (args.action, e.g. remind:set) or 'shell$<command>' (args.command).
